results.title: The thin blue wool line: Knitted police are tackling speeding drivers
results.description: Steve Allen looks at the village fighting speeding drivers with knitted police officers and wonders whether a woolly police force could be the answer.

results.description: Centrist Democrats’ calls to fall in line behind the party’s nominee only ever seem to cut one way — and fall apart when their candidate loses. The post The Spirit of “Party Unity, My Ass” Is Back and Coming for the DSA (and El-Sayed) appeared first on The Intercept.

results.title: France deploys thousands of police as Paris march is restricted to city’s edge
results.description: PARIS (AP) — Paris braced for a fresh march by students and workers over school funding and soaring living costs Saturday, one week after violent unrest left shops looted and cars burned. The new march was restricted to the city’s southeastern edge, away from the center, as police deployed in force across France.
